♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: With the Moon and Jupiter together in Cancer in Ashlesha in your 4th house, today stirs the roots of your emotional life. You may feel protective of your space, yet also eager to expand or improve it. The Sun in Leo in Purva Phalguni activates your 5th house, so beneath the homely mood there’s a playful, expressive current. Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 12th asks you to notice which old fears still live in the background and gently retire them.

💼 Career: This is not a classic “charge ahead” Aries workday. The 4th-house emphasis favours tasks done from a place of comfort—planning, drafting, or creative work that you can shape quietly before sharing. Jupiter’s influence can bring helpful support from family or someone who feels like family, letting you handle responsibilities with a softer heart. If you’re dealing with management or clients, lean into warmth and storytelling rather than hard selling; Sun in the 5th gives you natural charisma when you speak about what you genuinely care about.

❤️ Love: Home and heart are entwined. If partnered, you may feel like nesting more—cooking together, rearranging a room, or talking honestly about what “security” actually means to both of you. Jupiter with the Moon can magnify feelings, so minor issues might feel bigger; instead of reacting, use it as a chance to understand your own needs more clearly. If single, your attraction is likely to be toward people who feel emotionally safe and a bit playful. Someone connected through family, neighbourhood, or a childhood friend circle could catch your eye.

💰 Money: Jupiter in your 4th can bring focus to property, housing, or long-term stability. This is a supportive day for researching home-related investments, rent agreements, or saving plans that give you a stronger base over time. Sun in the 5th can tempt you into spontaneous pleasures or speculative risk; a little joy spending is fine, but check that it doesn’t nibble away at foundations you’re trying to strengthen. Think, “How will this choice feel to me six months from now?”

🧘 Advice: Let your drive express itself through protecting and upgrading your inner world rather than proving yourself outside. When your base feels solid, your natural courage returns on its own.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Every small act of care you give to your home and heart today becomes future fuel for your next bold move.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon–Jupiter pairing in Cancer in Ashlesha lights up your 3rd house of mind, messages, and short journeys. Your thoughts are busier and more emotionally coloured, but also full of insight. The Sun in Leo in Purva Phalguni activates your 4th house, drawing attention back to home and family. Your ruler Venus in early Libra in Chitra in your 6th gives you a quiet urge to refine your daily habits and make work more beautiful or balanced.

💼 Career: Today favours communication-heavy tasks: writing, client calls, coordination, and learning something new. The 3rd-house Moon with Jupiter can bring useful conversations or a piece of information that shifts your understanding of a project. With Venus supporting your 6th, you can smooth rough edges at work—improving a process, beautifying your workspace, or offering a tactful suggestion that benefits everyone. Just watch for emotional over-explaining; say enough, not everything.

❤️ Love: Words carry extra weight. If partnered, heartfelt texts, gentle check-ins, or talking about shared memories can feel especially nourishing. The Sun in your 4th may highlight family matters or living arrangements; discussions about where and how you want to live together can move forward if you keep the tone collaborative rather than defensive. If single, someone you meet on a short trip, in your local area, or through a sibling or neighbour could stand out. Notice whether conversation flows easily and whether they listen as much as they speak.

💰 Money: The 3rd house also governs small, repeated decisions. Today is good for adjusting subscriptions, phone/internet plans, commuting choices, or side-hustle logistics that influence finances over time. Venus in the 6th supports fair negotiations around payments for your work or services. If you’ve been undercharging out of politeness, you can begin to shift that by simply stating your real rates clearly and calmly.

🧘 Advice: Don’t underestimate the power of one clear conversation or one new piece of knowledge. Tiny mental upgrades now can lead to real-world stability later.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way you speak to others today quietly rewrites the script of how life speaks back to you.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: With the Moon and Jupiter together in Cancer in your 2nd house, your attention naturally turns toward resources, food, and the deeper values behind your choices. Your ruler Mercury has just moved into Virgo in Uttara Phalguni in your 4th, sharpening practical thinking around home, property, and family systems. The Sun in Leo in your 3rd keeps your day active, but underneath the busyness you’re asking, “What truly supports me?”

💼 Career: This is a favourable day for grounding your ideas in practical plans. The 2nd-house focus highlights your earning, your skills, and whether your current role reflects your worth. Mercury in Virgo helps you see details you’ve missed regarding contracts, schedules, or how you organize your work environment. You might feel drawn to tidy, document, or restructure your workflow; these seemingly small adjustments can significantly increase your effectiveness over the next few weeks.

❤️ Love: Emotional security and respect feel more important than flashy gestures. If partnered, conversations about shared priorities—how you spend money, where you invest time, what you’re building together—can be productive, provided you avoid slipping into criticism over small things. If single, you may feel pulled toward people who seem steady, grounded, and careful with their commitments. Pay attention to how someone treats their own time and resources; it will tell you a lot about how they’ll treat yours.

💰 Money: Moon–Jupiter in the 2nd can open a window for both generosity and overindulgence. It’s a good day to review your income and expenses with hopeful realism: what is growing, what needs pruning, and what small increase in your rates or savings habit would make a noticeable difference over time? Household or family-related expenses may come into focus; Mercury in the 4th supports negotiating better deals or planning future improvements in stages rather than all at once.

🧘 Advice: Bring your quick mind down into your body—notice how each choice around money, food, or time actually feels. Your nervous system is giving you data your intellect might skip.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your daily choices match your values, your confidence stops needing outside confirmation.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon—your ruler—is in your own sign Cancer in Ashlesha, joined by expansive Jupiter in your 1st house. This amplifies your sensitivity, intuition, and presence; people sense you strongly today. The Sun in Leo in Purva Phalguni highlights your 2nd house of self-worth and resources, while Mercury in Virgo in your 3rd helps you translate feelings into grounded, practical words.

💼 Career: With your 1st house lit up, you naturally stand out. This is a good day to initiate a proposal, share feedback, or step into a role that requires trust and emotional intelligence. Jupiter with the Moon can make you more optimistic and willing to consider bigger plans—but be sure you don’t promise more than your energy realistically allows. Use Mercury’s precision to define timelines and boundaries clearly. If a negotiation is on the table, you’re well-positioned to ask for terms that respect both your contribution and your wellbeing.

❤️ Love: Your emotional volume is turned up. If partnered, this can bring warmth, affection, and renewed closeness—especially if you share honestly about what’s been on your heart. It can also exaggerate mood swings, so give yourself a pause before reacting to small triggers. If single, your natural magnetism is higher; people may be drawn to your softness and sincerity. Choose those who make you feel spacious and at ease, not those who just admire you from a distance.

💰 Money: Sun in your 2nd and a strong 1st-house Moon put both income and self-respect in focus. You may feel ready to invest in something that supports your identity—training, personal care, or tools that boost your confidence. Just watch for emotionally driven splurges. A balanced approach today could be: one considered purchase that clearly improves your life, plus one concrete step toward financial structure, like automating a transfer or setting a realistic savings goal.

🧘 Advice: Let expansion start from inside your ribcage rather than from your to-do list. When you feel emotionally centered, the right opportunities naturally feel clearer and less forced.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The world tends to mirror the story you’re quietly telling about yourself—today gives you a chance to rewrite that story in your favour.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Sun in your own sign Leo in Purva Phalguni energises your 1st house, keeping your season of self-definition alive. Yet the Moon and Jupiter in Cancer in your 12th house pull part of you inward toward dreams, rest, and unresolved emotions. Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 8th adds a sober note around boundaries and shared responsibilities. It’s a day of both radiance and retreat.

💼 Career: Outwardly, you may still have duties to perform or a role to play, but your best work today happens when you combine visibility with reflection. Use your natural leadership to set a calmer pace rather than to push everyone harder. Background tasks—strategy, reviewing sensitive information, tying up loose ends in confidential projects—are favoured with the Moon in the 12th. If you feel a dip in motivation, don’t panic; it may simply be time to step back, observe, and adjust your direction before charging on.

❤️ Love: Your need for emotional privacy is heightened, even as the Sun makes you noticeable. If partnered, you might crave quieter, more soulful connection—sharing secrets, cuddling in silence, or gently debriefing about deeper topics you usually skim over. Avoid testing your partner by going silent; instead, express that you’re processing and invite them into your inner world at a pace that feels safe. If single, you may feel drawn to mysterious or spiritually inclined people, but be discerning; attraction born in the 12th house can sometimes blur red flags.

💰 Money: Saturn in your 8th continues its long lesson around shared resources, debts, and commitments, and today’s introspective Moon can help you see one of these patterns more clearly. This is a good time to review joint accounts, subscriptions you share with others, or emotional expectations around who pays for what. You don’t need all the answers today; even identifying one area where you’d like more transparency or fairness is progress.

🧘 Advice: Honour both sides of you—the one that shines and the one that needs to dissolve into quiet. Your power grows when you allow yourself to step backstage without judging it as weakness.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The decisions you make in private now will shape the kind of spotlight you stand in later.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Moon–Jupiter conjunction in Cancer in Ashlesha moves through your 11th house of networks, allies, and long-term aspirations. Your ruler Mercury is strong in Virgo in Uttara Phalguni in your 1st house, sharpening your discernment and giving you a clear, analytical voice. The Sun in Leo in your 12th house asks you to balance social engagement with quiet inner processing.

💼 Career: This is a strategic day for your future. With the 11th house lit up, conversations with colleagues, mentors, or friends can spark ideas about where you’d like your career to go next. Mercury in your sign gives you the capacity to articulate a plan or refine your role in a team with precision. You might see which projects truly align with your long-term goals and which simply drain you. It’s a good time to adjust commitments or to initiate contact with someone whose support could be meaningful down the line.

❤️ Love: You may feel simultaneously sociable and selective. If partnered, spending time with mutual friends or engaging in a shared community activity can bring a sense of being on the same side. Later, you may need some decompression time alone; communicate this instead of simply withdrawing. If single, interesting connections may come through groups, online spaces, or shared interests. Trust your finely tuned radar: you don’t need to force charm when observing and asking thoughtful questions already shows who is truly compatible.

💰 Money: Group-related finances—shared resources in a project, contributions to a collective, or income from networks—are highlighted. The Moon with Jupiter can bring an opportunity for gain through your connections, but also the temptation to overextend yourself for others. Mercury in your 1st supports reading the fine print and setting sane limits. Consider where a small increase in your professional visibility could open doors without requiring major risk.

🧘 Advice: Let your current clarity refine your circles and your goals, not just your to-do list. You’re allowed to choose the environments that genuinely support your growth.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The people and plans you say “yes” to now will quietly shape who you become known as later.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Moon and Jupiter conjoin in Cancer in Ashlesha at the top of your chart in your 10th house, spotlighting career, public image, and responsibility. Your ruler Venus has entered Libra in Chitra in your 1st house, restoring a sense of grace and self-alignment. The Sun in Leo in your 11th house ties your public role to your communities and long-term hopes.

💼 Career: Today carries a strong professional charge. Others are likely to notice your actions and emotional tone more than usual. The Moon–Jupiter emphasis can bring recognition, a larger task, or a chance to demonstrate maturity and care. With Venus in your sign, you’re well-equipped to handle visible responsibilities with charm and fairness. This is a good day to take ownership of a project, initiate a conversation with a superior, or represent your team. Just be mindful not to absorb everyone’s stress; lead with steadiness rather than people-pleasing.

❤️ Love: Because your public world is loud, you may need to consciously make space for intimacy. If partnered, sharing your current ambitions and worries openly can strengthen the bond; let them see both the polished and the uncertain parts of your day. A simple, beautiful ritual together—good food, a walk, or time without devices—can restore equilibrium. If single, you might be drawn to someone connected to your professional or social circles who recognises your talents. Take your time to see whether admiration turns into genuine understanding.

💰 Money: Career-related finances—salary, client payments, or business visibility—are in focus. Jupiter’s touch can offer growth potential, but it also calls for wise handling of any new responsibilities. Venus in your 1st encourages you to consider what financial arrangements actually feel harmonious rather than merely impressive. This could be a good day to explore upgrading your professional image or skills in ways that can support income later.

🧘 Advice: Stand where you are with quiet confidence. You don’t have to be perfect to be respected; you just have to be consistent and honest about what you can deliver.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way you carry yourself under pressure today will linger in people’s memories longer than you think.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Moon–Jupiter conjunction in Cancer in Ashlesha activates your 9th house of perspective, learning, and faith. Your traditional ruler Mars is in Gemini in Punarvasu in your 8th, keeping deeper psychological and financial themes humming. The Sun in Leo in your 10th illuminates your ambitions and public direction. It’s a day to connect inner depth with a wider view.

💼 Career: You’re well-placed for big-picture thinking. The 9th-house Moon with Jupiter favours exploring new approaches, mentors, courses, or philosophies that can expand your professional path. You may see how a current challenge fits into a longer story of growth. With Mars in your 8th, research, investigations, and complex negotiations are energised; combine that investigative drive with the 9th house’s wisdom, and you can make more strategic choices about which commitments to deepen and which to slowly release.

❤️ Love: You may crave relationships that feel meaningful rather than purely convenient. If partnered, conversations about life direction, beliefs, or future plans can feel especially alive; you might discuss travel, education, or shared projects that stretch both of you. Just be aware that Mars in the 8th can intensify emotions—if sensitive topics arise, aim for curiosity rather than control. If single, you may feel drawn to people from different backgrounds, or to those with a strong sense of purpose. Ask yourself whether their actions match the ideals they speak about.

💰 Money: The 8th and 9th houses activated together put a spotlight on how your financial agreements align with your ethics and long-term freedom. It’s a good day to seek advice—legal, financial, or spiritual—about debts, taxes, investments, or shared assets. You might recognise one belief about money that you inherited but no longer want to live by. Gently questioning that belief can open room for more sustainable and less fear-driven decisions.

🧘 Advice: When your mind circles a worry, widen the frame—ask how this situation might look from the viewpoint of your future self, or from a mentor you respect.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The choices you make from a higher perspective today can quietly rewire patterns that once felt unchangeable.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: Your ruler Jupiter joins the Moon in Cancer in Ashlesha in your 8th house, stirring deep waters—intimacy, shared resources, and psychological transformation. The Sun in Leo in your 9th house lifts your gaze toward meaning, travel, or study, giving you a helpful sense of context. Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 4th continues to reshape your sense of emotional foundation and family responsibilities.

💼 Career: Behind-the-scenes matters are highlighted: budgets, contracts, inheritances, investments, or collaborative projects where trust is key. With Jupiter involved, this can be a fruitful time to renegotiate terms, seek more equitable arrangements, or untangle old complexities. You may also gain insight into power dynamics at work—who actually holds influence and how resources are distributed. The Sun in your 9th encourages you not to get lost in intensity; bring questions of ethics and long-term vision into any decision you make.

❤️ Love: Emotional honesty is emphasised. If partnered, you may find yourselves talking about vulnerable topics—fears, past hurts, or how you share responsibilities and resources. If you approach these conversations gently, they can deepen trust. If single, you might feel drawn to people who carry some mystery or depth, but ensure that your curiosity is matched by a sense of safety and reciprocity. Old relationship patterns could resurface in your thoughts; instead of judging yourself, use this as raw material for wiser choices ahead.

💰 Money: The 8th-house activation makes shared finances, loans, and obligations more visible. It’s a constructive day to review debts, insurance, or joint accounts and to look for options that reduce pressure over time. Jupiter’s presence suggests that helpful support or a workable plan is available if you are willing to look closely and ask questions. Even one clarified agreement—who pays what, when, and why—can bring significant relief.

🧘 Advice: When strong feelings or complicated numbers show up, resist the urge to either ignore them or fix everything in one day. Choose one knot to patiently loosen.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The courage to look at what’s under the surface now becomes the quiet confidence you carry into your next chapter.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Moon–Jupiter conjunction in Cancer in Ashlesha moves through your 7th house of partnerships and open allies, turning the spotlight clearly toward “the other.” Saturn, your ruler, is retrograde in Pisces in your 3rd, fine-tuning how you think, speak, and handle boundaries in everyday interactions. The Sun in Leo in your 8th house brings depth to topics of trust, intimacy, and shared resources.

💼 Career: Collaboration is front and center. Clients, colleagues, or business partners may require more of your emotional presence today. You’re in a strong position to build or repair important professional relationships—through listening, showing steady reliability, and being transparent about expectations. The Sun in the 8th suggests that serious matters such as contracts, confidentiality, or shared budgets may arise; with Saturn in your 3rd, you can handle these through clear, measured communication rather than avoidance.

❤️ Love: Relationship weather is vivid. If partnered, your sensitivity to your partner’s needs is higher, as is theirs to yours. This can bring warmth, shared plans, or a desire to deepen commitment. It can also highlight where things feel unequal or unspoken. A gentle, structured conversation—perhaps even setting aside time specifically for it—can help you both feel safer. If single, people you meet now may act as mirrors, showing you the kind of dynamic you’re ready for or done with. Notice how you show up when you feel seen versus when you feel judged.

💰 Money: With the 7th and 8th houses involved, joint finances, agreements, and negotiations are in focus. You might be revisiting terms with a partner, service provider, or institution. Jupiter’s presence can bring a fair solution if you’re open to a win–win mindset. Saturn asks that you read details carefully and not rush, even if you’re eager to settle things. Aim for arrangements that respect both your responsibility and your limits.

🧘 Advice: You don’t have to carry every partnership on your shoulders. Let clarity and shared responsibility be forms of care, not confrontation.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The quality of your connections now is shaped less by how much you give and more by how honestly you agree.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon and Jupiter together in Cancer in Ashlesha activate your 6th house of work, health routines, and service. Saturn, your traditional ruler, retrograde in Pisces in your 2nd continues to teach you about sustainable earning and self-worth. The Sun in Leo in your 7th house illuminates important one-to-one relationships, both personal and professional.

💼 Career: This is a practical, industrious day if you work with, rather than against, your rhythms. The 6th-house Moon–Jupiter combo supports improving systems: adjusting schedules, refining workflows, and being generous yet boundaried with coworkers. You might feel more aware of where your time and energy leak away. Small, well-chosen changes—batching similar tasks, delegating one recurring duty, or setting clearer office hours—can have outsized impact. Interactions with clients or partners are highlighted by the Sun in the 7th; aim for balanced give-and-take.

❤️ Love: Relationships are influenced by the reality of daily life now. If partnered, discussions about chores, division of labour, or mutual support in health and stress management may come up. Rather than seeing these as unromantic, recognise that this is where most relationships actually live day to day. If single, you may notice potential connections in work or service environments—colleagues, collaborators, or people who share your sense of responsibility. Pay attention to how someone behaves under pressure; it reveals their capacity for partnership more than their charm.

💰 Money: Saturn in your 2nd keeps pointing you toward disciplined, realistic handling of resources. Today’s 6th-house activation shows you the link between your everyday habits and your financial situation. You might decide to cut one small recurring expense, improve how you track income, or commit to a more consistent work pattern. Jupiter’s touch in the 6th suggests that improving your skills or dependability can gradually lead to better opportunities.

🧘 Advice: Treat your body, schedule, and bank account as teammates on the same side rather than problems to fix. Cooperative routines will serve you far better than heroic bursts.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The freedom you want later is being built quietly in how you handle today’s simple obligations.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Moon–Jupiter conjunction in Cancer in Ashlesha lights up your 5th house of creativity, children, romance, and heartfelt expression. Your traditional ruler Jupiter is at home in a water sign, amplifying intuition and imaginative flow. Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 1st house keeps you aware of your limits and responsibilities, but today that seriousness is softened by genuine joy. The Sun in Leo in your 6th house connects inspiration to daily effort.

💼 Career: This is an excellent day for any work that benefits from originality, storytelling, design, or a personal touch. The 5th house emphasis supports pitching ideas, creating content, or bringing more of your natural style into what you do. The Sun in the 6th reminds you that inspiration needs a container: choose one or two key ideas and give them structured time rather than scattering your attention. Saturn in your sign can help you say “no” to distractions so your “yes” to meaningful work has room to breathe.

❤️ Love: Your romantic and playful side is more visible. If partnered, you may crave lighter, more joyful moments together—jokes, shared hobbies, or simply time that isn’t focused on problems to solve. This can be especially healing if things have felt heavy lately. If single, your charm is quietly magnetic; people may be drawn to your creativity and openness. Look for interactions where you feel seen for who you are, not just what you can provide emotionally.

💰 Money: Finances are influenced by how you relate to enjoyment now. You might feel tempted to spend on entertainment, children, or creative pursuits. Rather than shutting this down completely, Saturn in your 1st invites you to give pleasure a reasonable budget and clear limits. On the upside, the 5th–6th house link can support monetising a skill or hobby if you’re willing to approach it with consistency and professionalism.

🧘 Advice: Let yourself follow what genuinely enlivens you, but pair each burst of inspiration with one grounded step. That’s how dreams slowly become parts of your ordinary life.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you allow joy and responsibility to sit at the same table, life stops feeling like a choice between your heart and your duties.
